title: Session metrics pocketbook

body:
Quick reference / rationale:
- Purpose: one-page quick sheet to eyeball session outcomes.
- When I open this: look for throughput vs p95 tradeoffs and flag runs to reproduce.
- Kept intentionally terse: experiments are tagged with short IDs that map to PRs/tickets.

How I use it:
- Prioritize runs with stable p95 under 3x p50 and throughput above target for SKU.
- If cost_per_1k_tokens drops >20% with quality pass, mark for follow-up.

Immediate TODOs:
- [ ] Re-run S-132 with newer CUDA kernels (perf team branch).
- [ ] Add small quality-check column (BLEU/ctrl-score) to spot-check quantized variants.
- [ ] Convert promising q4_0 variants to ci-smoke tests.

Notes and shorthand legend:
- fp16 = 16-bit float baseline; q4_0/q4_1/q8_1 = quant levels; cache-on = prefix/KV cache enabled; hybrid = partial kv + prefix cache; dynamic-batching notes the serving runtime change.
- cost_per_1k_tokens is back-of-envelope (compute + infra), useful for quick ordering but not billing-accurate.

Scratch math examples (put here so I don't lose quick calcs):
- throughput_tok_s = total_tokens_generated / wall_time; cost per 1k tokens ~ (gpu_minute_cost * minutes) / (tokens/1000)
- If batch increases from 8->16 and throughput improves <1.6x, look at kernel saturation or memory bandwidth.
